anchorReview.visual: The mutation remains a temporary Audralia arrival overlay and strengthens the established H-Earth-family world-initialization language with a visibly chromatic blue, violet, teal and gold treatment plus explicit COLOR ARRIVAL v4 build identity. It does not substitute a dashboard, map application, or separate product for the world.
anchorReview.interaction: No camera, travel, look, gesture, world navigation, renderer geometry, or world interaction behavior is changed. Loader-progress changes only expose delayed startup after 15 seconds and an already-recorded reconciliation initialization error. The celestial bootstrap only sequences the existing celestial checkpoint behind established renderer authority so its independent startup timeout cannot expire before that authority exists.
anchorReview.continuity: The same five-stage runtime predicates remain authoritative for world readiness. The loader still resolves into the same canonical Audralia world. Celestial rendering remains the existing AUDRALIA_CELESTIAL_CONTEXT_v2 implementation and is initialized only after the same renderer authority already used by the world reconciliation runtime.
